checklist.evidence: Diagnosis names Deployment/vigil-app and its mem-load container, matching the ground-truth target component.
It identifies the mem-load memory limit as the origin; BackOff restarts are presented only as resulting symptoms.
No healthy or unrelated component is blamed; only Deployment/vigil-app:mem-load is identified as faulty.
Diagnosis identifies an excessively low container memory limit causing OOMKills, matching the injected container_memory_limit mechanism.
It specifies mem-load, the 32Mi limit, stress-ng --vm-bytes 50M, and the exact vigil-app.yaml manifest path.
The diagnosis consistently attributes failure to the memory limit and does not introduce an unrelated fault type.
Attribution remains limited to the vigil-app mem-load sidecar; no additional components are blamed.
Both ground-truth elements, Deployment/vigil-app and container mem-load, are explicitly included.
Repeated OOMKills, failed starts, BackOff, and restarts are consistent with a 32Mi limit below the 50M workload.

diagnosis_text:

 root_cause: The mem-load stress container in Deployment/vigil-app declares a 32Mi memory limit but runs stress-ng with --vm-bytes 50M, so each allocation loop exceeds the cgroup limit and the container is OOMKilled on every start; the bad limit is present in git, so the declared manifest must be corrected. root_cause_component: Deployment/vigil-app:mem-load (stress-ng --vm-bytes 50M under memory limit 32Mi)
 recommended_action: git_commit_k8s
